{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify internal test orders: those with 'converted' = 0
# Filter for completed orders that are not test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['converted'] == 1)]

# Drop any rows with missing revenue (NaN)
filtered_df = filtered_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue'].sum()

# Also, count how many rows were included to understand the data quality
count_completed_non_test = len(filtered_df)

# Return both total revenue and count
total_revenue, count_completed_non_test"}
